app.name: Immulea
app.tagline: Scan a product, understand what's in it.
nav.label: Read a label
disclaimer: Indicative wellness information. Does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional. Is neither a diagnosis nor a treatment.
draft.notice: The criteria behind this score have not yet been reviewed by a healthcare professional.
scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Place the barcode inside the frame.
scan.manual.title: Or type the code
scan.manual.label: Barcode (8 to 14 digits)
scan.manual.invalid: This barcode is not valid. Check the digits.
scan.camera.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings, or type the code by hand.
scan.camera.notfound: No camera detected. Type the code by hand.
scan.camera.error: Could not start the camera. Type the code by hand.
result.insufficient.title: Not enough data
result.insufficient.body: This product's composition is missing or too incomplete: we prefer not to invent a score.
result.alt.title: A possible alternative
error.notFound.title: Product not found
error.notFound.body: This product is not (yet) in the Open Food Facts database. You can photograph its label.
error.offline.title: You are offline
error.offline.body: Connect to the Internet to look up a product.
error.upstream.title: Service temporarily unavailable
error.upstream.body: The product database is not responding. Try again in a moment.
error.generic.title: Something went wrong
error.rateLimited.body: Too many requests. Please wait a little before trying again.
label.title: Read a label
label.intro: Take a photo of the ingredients list. The image is analysed and then deleted immediately: it is never kept.
label.privacy: To read the label, the photo is sent to our server and then to an AI service (Anthropic). It is not stored.
label.error.invalid: Invalid image. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo under 4 MB.
label.error.unreadable: Could not read an ingredients list from this photo. Get closer and make sure the lighting is good.
label.error.generic: The analysis failed. Try again in a moment.
label.result.name: Product (photographed label)
consent.title: Save your history on this device?
consent.body: Knowing that you follow a health profile (for example "Hashimoto") counts as health data. With your explicit consent, the app can keep your profiles, scan history, favourites, diet and symptom tracking ONLY on this device. Nothing is sent to a server. You can withdraw your consent and erase everything at any time in Settings.
consent.refused.note: OK: nothing will be saved. The app remains usable.
history.title: History
history.disabled: Saving your history is turned off. You can turn it on in Settings.
settings.title: Settings
settings.delete.help: Erases consent, profile, history, favourites, saved recipes, fridge, preferences and caches on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.delete.confirm: Permanently delete all your local data?
settings.delete.done: All your data has been deleted from this device.
reason.high_sugar_content: High sugar content (15 g or more per 100 g)
onboarding.deleted: Your data has been deleted from this device.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome
onboarding.welcome.body: Immulea helps you read what's in food: scan a barcode and get an indicative score with the precise reasons (ingredients, additives).
onboarding.welcome.p1: No account, no ads, no tracking.
onboarding.welcome.p2: Your data stays on your device.
onboarding.welcome.p3: A guide to reading labels better, not medical advice.
onboarding.profile.title: Your profiles
onboarding.profile.body: Tick one or more profiles: they determine the criteria used to calculate the score.
onboarding.profile.more: With several profiles ticked, a product is flagged as soon as it is not recommended for any one of them. You can change this later in Settings.
profile.hashimoto.desc: Indicative dietary criteria for people with Hashimoto's.
onboarding.final.title: Before you start
onboarding.ack: I have read and understand this warning
onboarding.ack.required: Tick the box above to continue.
onboarding.consent.title: Save my profile on this device?
onboarding.refuse.note: If you decline, the app works with the profile you chose for the session, without saving anything (no profile, history or favourites). Declining also erases any data already saved.
settings.textsize.sample: Example: the text adapts to your choice.
settings.errors.label: Send anonymous error reports
settings.errors.help: Off by default. If you turn it on, crashes are sent to a server in the EU, without barcode, product name, search, profile or favourite. You can turn it off at any time.
favorites.title: Favourites
favorites.empty: No favourites yet. Tap the heart on a product page to add one.
favorites.disabled: Favourites are stored on your device and need your consent to save locally.
favorites.needConsent: Turn on local saving in Settings to use favourites.
search.title: Search for a product
search.label: Product name or brand
search.empty: No results. Try another name, or scan the barcode.
search.invalid: Characters not allowed. Use letters, digits, spaces, hyphens or apostrophes.
search.privacy: Your search is neither saved nor logged by the app.
error.boundary.title: The app ran into a problem
error.boundary.body: Nothing was lost. You can try again.
recipes.disclaimer: Recipe idea generated automatically, compatible with your profile's rules. Always check labels and allergens. Does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional.
recipes.cta.help: 3 to 5 recipes built around this product, compatible with your profile's rules.
recipes.seed.incompatible: This product contains an ingredient ruled out by your profile: no recipe from it. You can build recipes from other foods in My fridge.
recipes.consent.title: Before sending your list
recipes.consent.body: The ingredient list will be sent to an AI provider located outside the EU to generate recipes. Your profile and diagnosis are never sent.
recipes.consent.detail: Only ingredient names and a list of categories to avoid (for example "gluten-free") are sent, with no identifier. The app keeps nothing from this request. You can withdraw your consent at any time in Settings.
recipes.consent.check: I understand and agree to this ingredient list being sent
recipes.loading: Creating recipes… this can take a few seconds.
recipes.fav.needConsent: Turn on local saving in Settings to keep recipes.
recipes.fav.full: You have reached the maximum of {max} saved recipes.
recipes.saved.title: My recipes
recipes.saved.empty: No saved recipes. Tap the heart on a recipe to keep it, even offline.
recipes.saved.disabled: Saved recipes are kept on your device and need your consent to save locally.
recipes.saved.offline: These recipes are saved on your device: they stay available offline.
recipes.error.quota: You have used all your free generations this month. Your saved recipes remain available.
recipes.error.rate: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
recipes.error.unavailable: The recipe service is temporarily unavailable. Try again a little later.
recipes.error.failed: Could not generate recipes right now. Try again in a moment.
recipes.error.offline: You are offline. Generating recipes needs a connection. Your saved recipes remain available.
recipes.error.notenough: Not enough compatible recipes, try adding other ingredients.
recipes.error.notfound: This product cannot be found: no recipes can be suggested.
recipes.error.invalid: The request is not valid. Check the ingredient list and try again.
recipes.error.incompatible: None of these foods is compatible with your profile's rules. Try other ingredients.
recipes.error.title: Recipes unavailable
fridge.title: My fridge
fridge.intro: Add what you have on hand, then ask for recipe ideas compatible with your profile.
fridge.add.label: Add a food
fridge.add.invalid: This name is not valid. Use letters, digits, spaces or hyphens (50 characters maximum).
fridge.add.duplicate: This food is already in your fridge.
fridge.scan.notfound: Product not found: add it by hand.
fridge.scan.error: Could not read this product right now. Add it by hand.
fridge.empty: Your fridge is empty. Add foods to generate recipes.
fridge.generate: Generate recipes with what I have
fridge.incompatible: Ruled out by your profile: ignored for recipes
fridge.session: Without consent to save locally, your fridge is kept for this session only.
fridge.privacy: The list only leaves your device when you ask for recipes (after your consent).
settings.recipes.on: You agreed to the ingredient list being sent to an AI provider located outside the EU to generate recipes.
settings.recipes.off: Nothing is sent until you give your consent (asked before the first generation).
tour.welcome.title: Let's take a tour
tour.welcome.body: In a few steps, we show you where to find each feature. You can skip at any time.
tour.scan.title: Scan
tour.scan.body: Opens the camera to scan a barcode. The score appears with the precise reasons.
tour.manual.title: No camera?
tour.manual.body: Type the barcode number by hand: you get the same result.
tour.search.title: Search
tour.search.body: Type a product's name to find it, no barcode needed.
tour.label.title: Read a label
tour.label.body: No barcode? Photograph the ingredients list to analyse it.
tour.favorites.title: Favourites
tour.favorites.body: Find your favourite products again with the heart on each page.
tour.recipes.title: Recipes
tour.recipes.body: Your saved recipes, to mark as tested or approved.
tour.history.title: History
tour.history.body: Find the products you scanned recently.
tour.settings.title: Settings
tour.settings.body: Theme, text size, your data… You can replay this tour here at any time.
dash.title: My progress
dash.disabled: Turn on local saving to track your progress (scans, recipes, symptoms). Everything stays on your device.
dash.global.hint: {pct}% of steps completed (scans, recipes, symptom tracking).
diet.title: My diet
diet.strict.help: The rules are applied as they are.
diet.test.help: Reintroduction phase: test only one new food at a time and note your symptoms.
diet.souple.help: More tolerant thresholds: a product turns green or orange more easily. Important alerts (e.g. gluten) stay visible.
diet.test.hint: Test mode: only one new food at a time, in a small amount, then note your symptoms over the following hours and days.
symptoms.title: Symptom tracking
symptoms.intro: One entry a day, in 30 seconds. It helps you spot what does you good or not.
symptoms.disabled: Tracking is saved only on your device, with your consent. You can turn it on in the
symptoms.disclaimer: This tracking is a personal guide. It does not replace medical advice: talk to your doctor about your symptoms.
veggie.title: Vegetarian / vegan?
veggie.vegan: Vegan based on the known ingredients and additives
veggie.uncertain: Origin to check (animal or plant depending on the manufacturer): {items}
veggie.note: Indicative: check for a "vegan" or "vegetarian" mark on the packaging if in doubt.
recipes.status.title: Where are you with this recipe?
label.error.unavailable.title: Label analysis unavailable
label.error.unavailable.body: Photo reading is not available right now. You can search for the product by name or type its barcode.
label.error.noimage: The photo could not be read. Try again with a well-lit JPEG or PNG photo.
tour.diet.title: Your diet
tour.diet.body: Strict, testing or flexible: the score adapts to your level of strictness.
tour.progress.title: Your progress
tour.progress.body: Scans, tested and approved recipes, symptom tracking: it all fills up over time.
symptoms.week.count: {n} day(s) filled in out of 7. Average score: 1 = very hard, 5 = very good.
lang.title: Language
onboarding.profile.positive: Having restrictions doesn't mean you can't eat well: we look for what does you good, not what you're missing.
onboarding.profile.required: Choose at least one profile to continue.
settings.profile.help: You can tick several: a product is flagged as soon as it is not recommended for any one of them.
profile.basedow.desc: Autoimmune hyperthyroidism: watch iodine and stimulants.
profile.coeliaque.desc: Zero gluten: any gluten or trace is flagged red.
profile.lupus.desc: Minimally processed foods, low salt, no alfalfa.
profile.polyarthrite.desc: Anti-inflammatory eating: fewer ultra-processed foods and added sugars.
profile.sep.desc: Less saturated fat, salt and ultra-processed food.
profile.psoriasis.desc: Less alcohol, added sugar and saturated fat.
profile.diabete1.desc: Guidance on sugars and carbohydrates. Does not replace your own counting.
profile.sjogren.desc: Less sugar (dry mouth, cavities) and alcohol.
reason.high_salt: High salt content (1.5 g or more per 100 g)
reason.high_saturated_fat: High in saturated fat (5 g or more per 100 g)
reason.high_carbs: High in carbohydrates (60 g or more per 100 g)
reason.high_fat: High in fat (30 g or more per 100 g)
halal.title: Halal?
halal.certified: Halal label present on the product page
halal.compatible: Nothing forbidden spotted in the known ingredients
halal.meat: Meat or poultry: the slaughter method cannot be verified ({items}). Look for the halal logo on the packaging.
halal.note: Indicative: only a halal certification is conclusive. If in doubt, check the packaging or ask the manufacturer.
progress.title: My progress over time
progress.week.help: The last 7 days, day by day.
progress.month.help: The last 5 weeks, week by week.
progress.year.help: The last 12 months, month by month.
progress.note: The day-by-day history starts with this update. It stays only on your device.
tour.menu.title: Menu
tour.menu.body: The three bars open your recipes, your progress (week, month, year) and settings.
tour.lang.title: Language
tour.lang.body: Switch to French, English or Arabic with this button, or in settings.
gi.title: Glycaemic index (estimate)
gi.nocarbs: Few carbohydrates (under 5 g per 100 g): the glycaemic index is not relevant.
gi.note: Low: 55 or less. Medium: 56 to 69. High: 70 or more. Indicative estimate from the main ingredients: the real index depends on preparation, cooking and the rest of the meal. Does not replace your own monitoring, especially with diabetes.
disclaimer.short: Indicative wellness information, not a diagnosis or treatment.
onboarding.legal.sentence: I have read the {terms} and the {privacy}.
